title: Secret Scoring and Commodity Offers
description: Two fixes. (1) The objective-scoring dialog only had rows for revealed public objectives: in the status phase an offered secret objective had no row at all, and with no public objective revealed it was filed under Stage I as its raw alias ("Baf", "Public Objective"). Secrets now have their own section with name, printed condition, VP and scoring phase, plus the rest of the seat's hand marked not scoreable now. (2) Exploration rewards that gain, replenish, spend or convert commodities (Merchant Station, Abandoned Warehouses, Functioning Base, Local Fabricators), the Trade secondary, Hacan's agent and the Crimson Legionnaire now show the seat's commodities of its limit and its trade goods. Before shots are taken on the commit without the change; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- CK. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

notes.title: Secrets
notes.text: presentation/scoringOptions.ts reads an option id as a secret (only the secret catalog knows it, or a Plots Within Plots plot|<secret>|<seat> id); ObjectivesModal renders those in a Your Secret Objectives section, and the asked seat's other held secrets as non-selectable rows. Engine option ids and answers are unchanged.

notes.title: Commodities
notes.text: The engine attaches details.commodities = {have, max, trade_goods} (Choice::details: display only, never in records, canonical() or the fingerprint) to the commodity exploration rewards, the Trade secondary, Hacan's agent and the Crimson Legionnaire. The web shows it in the exploration card, the secondary panel, or a small panel above the options.
